Contact Sheet examples

Every page of a Flutter app as one map: each state of each page as an image, each transition as an arrow. Below are the maps of the three example apps, exported from this repository's main.

  • shop_app

    Navigation
    go_router: a redirect for guests, a deep link, pages pushed over others
    State
    riverpod
    Previews
    none in the app: all in the sheet package, started through the app's router

    index.html · map.svg · map-dev.svg · sheet.json

  • notes_app

    Navigation
    Navigator 1.0: named routes with arguments, a new note as a full-screen dialog
    State
    an InheritedNotifier
    Previews
    all the app's own, each a MultiPreview of a phone and a tablet: no sheet package. Shot in three variants: iPhone, Android, tablet

    index.html · map.svg · map-dev.svg · sheet.json

  • tabs_app

    Navigation
    Bottom tabs, Navigator.push without route names
    State
    a global service locator
    Previews
    the app's for the tabs and the post; the sheet package's for signing in, a full-screen dialog over the profile tab

    index.html · map.svg · map-dev.svg · sheet.json

The sheets and the apps are in example/ of koji-1009/contact_sheet.
